correctness.rationale: For symmetric-rate CTMC trees, exact first-step equations yield the source-side-component edge formula H_uv=sum s_e/w_e. Averaging ordered leaf pairs gives exactly four linear reciprocal-rate expressions. Cauchy--Schwarz supplies a lower certificate for every independent allocation; three explicit positive dual combinations match the exhibited feasible rates. The dual coefficient equality cases force individual-edge uniqueness, including both thresholds. Standalone replay verifies 12 exact rational CTMC systems, 720 randomized dual certificates, 8640 nonuniform allocation comparisons, and 48 phase transitions. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Targeted literature searches, previously examined mathematical statements and three relevant literature lines were compared by objective, topology, normalization, and implication. The closest general study optimizes sum of resistances rather than worst oriented continuous-time first-hitting times; star and path hitting-time claims do not cover the balanced two-hub motif. Xu-Yau 2013 supplies hitting-time methods but no rate budget optimizer. Neither a three-phase threshold nor an unrestricted uniqueness formula was found. value.rationale: The balanced double star is the first natural two-center tree beyond a single star; two directional crossing constraints compete with within-class hitting. The exact piecewise optimizer has two sharp, qualitatively different price thresholds, one independent of bridge price, with a genuine kink/active-constraint change and an unrestricted uniqueness result. This provides a checkable benchmark for cost-sensitive reversible first-passage network design and does not merely reparameterize prior resistance objectives.
